name: button-group
title: Button Group
description: Related actions arranged as one control group.

files.content:
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "react";

export function ButtonGroup({ className = "", orientation = "horizontal", ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical" }) { return <div role="group" className={`co-inline-flex ${orientation === "vertical" ? "co-flex-col co-divide-y co-divide-black/15" : "co-divide-x co-divide-black/15"} co-overflow-hidden co-rounded-md co-border co-border-black/15 ${className}`.trim()} {...props} />; }

meta.accessibility: Uses semantic HTML, preserves keyboard operation, exposes visible focus, and keeps accessible naming under consumer control.
